defaults.descriptionHtml: A small elemental totem summoned by @UUID[Item.ElTotem1a2b3c4d5]{Elemental Totem}.

totems.name: Cleansing Totem
totems.effectHtml: Cleansing: Once per round, each ally within range can heal one condition of their choice at the end of their turn.

totems.name: Flametongue Totem
totems.effectHtml: Flametongue: Once per round, each ally within range deals D4 extra damage with one attack or spell.

totems.name: Stoneskin Totem
totems.effectHtml: Stoneskin: Once per round, each ally within range takes D4 less damage from one attack or spell.

totems.name: Windfury Totem
totems.effectHtml: Windfury: Once per round, each ally within range gains a boon on one attack roll.
